_doc: Thiên Xu Tông's Effect engine records (world-depth Stage 6; ADR-0009), staged by the record pass. The input to tools/design/combat_sim/put_effects.py, which merges them into assets/data/combat_effects.json under source world-depth:thien_xu. Unpriced. Rule text from design/world/depth/sects/thien_xu.items.json and the authored wish d8; each rule pins its vague words. A 'Weight' is an Earth debuff stack on the foe (the Heavenly Pivot True Canon's own definition). 'Your ward' is your main ward (the one every fighter holds while it has linh lực) unless a rule says the stance ward. 'Strike nothing' is the Composed clock's reading (Combat rule 25, ruling 2026-11-26): no damaging or movement art and no evade (an evade is an act and a move); the basic attack, wards, heals and your companions do not count.

The Pole Draws from the Vein.rule: Heavenly Pivot True Canon, a passive art from layer 4 (authored wish d8): while you are Composed, you regain 0.2 % of your maximum linh lực each second for every 3 Earth stacks (Weights) on the foe, rounded down, with no cap.
The Pole Draws from the Vein.pending: the loader does not attach a technique's Effects yet (pending word technique-effects); run it with tree_effects

records.id: eff:The Pole Draws from the Vein

Sealed Writ.rule: North Star Seal: the first foe you strike with a seal art each fight (the first seal-tagged hit that lands) is Sealed for 4 s: its guard is broken open (Exposed, the engine's reading of "its wards hold half their value") and each second its largest buff pile is stripped (the engine's reading of "it cannot gain new buffs").
Sealed Writ.approx: "wards hold half their value" is Exposed (-100 resistance, 4 s); "cannot gain new buffs" is a strip of its largest buff pile each second for 4 s

Seven Lamps Turn.rule: Seven-Star Array Flag: each formation art you fire (an art tagged formation, such as The Pivot Does Not Turn or Plant the Stele) lights one of seven star-lamps. At the seventh, your ward holds twice as much for 5 s (the engine's reading of "your next ward is doubled") and the foe gains 2 Earth stacks for 10 s; then the lamps go out.

Weighed.rule: Weight of the Heavenly Balance: a foe hit by your seal art (a seal-tagged hit that lands) carries a Weight, an Earth stack for 6 s; with it the foe is cursed with Heavy Breath (its arts cost 25 % more, the engine's nearest to 20 %) for 6 s, which curses clamp to 5 s. The dialogue half (a lie told to you while it carries the Weight is known) is not a fight rule: NPC Interaction & Dialogue's.
Weighed.approx: "arts cost 20 % more" is Heavy Breath (25 %), clamped to 5 s; the dialogue half is not run in a fight

The Called Blow.rule: Army-Breaker Spear (authored wish d21): after 3 s in which you strike nothing (no damaging or movement art and no evade, the Composed clock; your companions', summons' and the basic attack's hits do not count), your next spear art is a certain crit and ignores block. If its hit leaves a ward of the foe broken (its main ward down for want of linh lực, or a stance ward it raised gone), the wait for the next called blow (that one only) is halved to 1.5 s.

Beat to Quarters.rule: War Drum of the Seventh Star: when you fire a summon or formation art (one tagged summon or formation), the drum musters your side: one free Physical hit of 0.5 at once (the engine's reading of "every companion and summon you command strikes once"). Once each 10 s.
Beat to Quarters.approx: the muster is one free hit of 0.5; the engine has no readable for how many companions and summons are out

Envoys Are Not Struck.rule: Envoy's Jade Tally: until you strike (your art or basic attack lands a hit), the first hit on you each fight is halved (you heal half of what it did at once), and while you have struck no one your escape rolls cannot fail (escape +100: you may leave at once, if you hold an escape art).

Know the Way Out.rule: Envoy's Jade Tally (authored wish d2): each escape you fail this fight makes your next escape 10 % likelier (escape +10, no cap); a success ends the fight, which clears it.

The Ink Remembers.rule: Inkstone of the Compact: each seal art you fire writes the foe's name in the stone. From the third writing in one fight, your curses on it last twice as long (status duration +100 % for curses; the curse clamp of 5 s still holds). The engine reads a curse's duration without the art that laid it, so this covers all your curses, not only the seal arts'.
The Ink Remembers.approx: all your curses, not only the seal arts' (a status's duration is read without its art)

True Gold Shows.rule: Assayer's Touchstone: you know the grade of any item you hold or are offered, and whether it is a forgery. A trade and appraisal rule (Item Database and the market), not a fight rule.
True Gold Shows.not_run: out of fight: an appraisal rule for the market and item screens, no fight record

True to the Line.rule: Square-and-Compass Flag: your Stele charges last 3 s longer (15 s, not 12). Stele charges are never worn by foe hits in the engine, so the "not worn" half needs nothing. Anchor charges are not in this pass (no Thiên Xu record grants one).

The Banner Is Raised.rule: Armoured Horse Banner: while you hold the banner, each hit of your companions and summons lays a Darkness stack on the foe. ("Your summons take a quarter less damage" is dropped: companions and summons are never struck, Combat rule 19.)
The Banner Is Raised.not_run: no holder (the banner is lost in abode A-3) and Darkness is not an engine element (darkness-element: decision not_run, checkpoint 2026-11-27, until Darkness's stack effect is ruled); the full record is kept in production/plans/stage6/thien_xu-checkpoint.md

Seal and Weight in One Hand.rule: Regalia of the Pivot, full set: once each fight, when a foe below half its health carries 5 or more Earth stacks (Weights), it is judged: its clock stops for 2 s (the stun), its largest buff pile is stripped (its strongest buff), and its guard is broken open (Exposed for 4 s, the engine's reading of "its wards broken"). While you hold all three, your own ward holds half as much (one who judges alone stands alone).
Seal and Weight in One Hand.approx: "its wards broken" is Exposed for 4 s; "strongest buff" is its largest buff pile

The Army That Waits.rule: The Armoured Horse, full set (2 pieces): once a fight, at its start, the riders join you as a summon for 10 s (a Physical strike of 0.6 every 2 s); the first companion or summon hit after they join makes the foe's soonest art wait 0.5 s. Outside a fight, the pair opens Thiết Mã Cảnh and commands the army in it: a world event, not a stat (not run here).
The Army That Waits.approx: the riders are a summon (0.6 every 2 s for 10 s); the realm half is a world event

The Called Thrust.rule: Army-Breaker's Harness, full set: each full second in which you strike nothing (no damaging or movement art and no evade: the Composed clock, Combat rule 25) lays 1 Earth stack for 12 s on the foe. The Army-Breaker's waited thrust (The Seventh Star Falls) spends them all as it fires, before it strikes; if it spends 5 or more, it first breaks the foe's guard entirely: Exposed for 4 s, laid before its hit lands (the engine's reading of "breaks the foe's ward entirely"). Spent before the strike, they no longer weigh on the thrust's own hit (the Pivot's Metal bonus per Earth stack reads 0 for it). The engine cannot tell which Earth stacks the waiting laid, so the thrust counts and spends every Earth stack on the foe, the Pivot's Weights too.
The Called Thrust.approx: "breaks the foe's ward entirely" is Exposed for 4 s; "them all" is every Earth stack on the foe, not only those the waiting laid

Sentence Stands.rule: Bridge Court Pair, full set (2 pieces): a curse you lay on a foe who carries your Weight (an Earth stack) lasts 2 s longer (status duration +50 % for curses, about 2 s on the 4 s curses; the 5 s clamp holds). "It cannot be cleansed" waits for the pending word curse-fast.
Sentence Stands.pending: "cannot be cleansed" needs the pending word curse-fast (pending.json)

The Weakest File.rule: Drum, Flag and Spear, full set: each time the drum strikes (Beat to Quarters fires), the foe is marked as the weak file for 6 s; while it is marked, your spear arts and your companions' and summons' strikes pierce its resistances (40 resistance points ignored, about a fifth of a same-realm foe's). "The foe with the least health" and "when it dies the drum strikes again" fall away in a one-against-one fight.
The Weakest File.approx: "a fifth of its resistances" is 40 resistance points (pen); the multi-foe clauses are dropped

Words Before Needles.rule: Envoy's Credentials, full set: each attack you evade loads one needle into the fan, and each second in which you strike (fire a damaging or movement art; an evade alone is not a strike, though a ward or heal fired in the very instant of an evade reads as one) one needle falls out. Your next fan art (an art tagged needle, such as Needle Rain, or the fan's own Fan Gust, tagged artifact) throws them all: a free Physical hit of 0.1 per needle, no cap. Leaving the fight when you have struck no one is the Envoy's Jade Tally's rule (Envoys Are Not Struck), a piece of this set.

The Door Stays Shut.rule: Keeper's Desk, full set: each seal art you fire while Composed (as read at the last second's mark, since a damaging art ends Composed as it fires) lays a seal-ward: your stance ward grows by 4 % of your health (the engine's reading of "4 % of your linh lực"), and each seal-ward loses a tenth of its first value each second, so it is gone in 10 s. Once the inkstone has written the foe's name three times (The Ink Remembers), each seal art you fire holds its arts: its soonest art waits 2 s (the engine's reading of "those that come ready in the next 2 s wait until the 2 s end").
The Door Stays Shut.approx: a seal-ward is stance ward of 4 % of health, not of linh lực; the hold is the foe's soonest art waiting 2 s

True Line.rule: Plumb and Level, full set: while the foe carries your Metal stacks, your hits cannot miss (accuracy +100; the engine reads accuracy without the hit's context, so it is all your hits, not only sword arts). Every fifth sword hit in a row (sword-tagged art hits that land; another art's hit breaks the row, the basic attack does not) sends one of the Hundred Swords down the same line at no cost: a free Physical hit of 0.6, a Flying Blade's strike.
True Line.approx: accuracy is all your hits; the Hundred Swords' blade is a free hit of 0.6

Before the Sun.rule: Dawn Pair, full set (2 pieces): your first sword art each fight is a certain crit; if its hit does not make the foe Broken, your ward holds twice as much for 5 s (the engine's reading of "your next ward is doubled": every fighter has a ward). Her master's lesson, half learned.

A Fair Copy.rule: Copyist's Pair, full set (2 pieces): once a fight, the first soul art that would land on you does nothing to you and strikes its caster as Cold damage equal to its own (the soul reflect, W2: the engine's reading of "copied, and your next seal art carries it back"). The curse half (the first curse cast on you copied back) is not run: the curse-reflect word was not built (checkpoint 2026-11-27: one half of one Effect, no other owner asks for it).
A Fair Copy.approx: the soul art is reflected at once, not carried back by your next seal art; the curse half is not run (curse-reflect: decision not_run, checkpoint 2026-11-27)
